01 / THESIS

Not another
launchpad.

Launchpads end when the token starts trading. Totem starts there.

It is a reusable policy layer that reads durable commitment and verifiable actions, then writes those signals into NFTs that evolve, grant access, carry credentials, and enter games.

COMMITMENT+PARTICIPATION→LIVING OWNERSHIP

04 / TRUST MODEL

Rules before vibes.

01

Durable proof

Windowed balance checkpoints and time-weighted commitment—not one manipulable snapshot.

02

Bound receipts

Every challenge proof names its issuer, subject, campaign, action, nonce, expiry, and provenance hash.

03

Scoped power

Creator roles, treasury caps, timelocked rule changes, pause controls, and an exit-safe ownership model.

04

Honest boundaries

Simulation is labeled. Tokens and NFTs only appear where portable ownership or public coordination adds value.
